image_description: The image displays two grey whales (Eschrichtius robustus) vertically breaching or spy-hopping out of blue ocean water. The larger whale on the right is positioned higher, showing its ventral side and head, while a smaller whale on the left is partially submerged. The skin exhibits characteristic mottled grey patterns with white barnacle patches. No dorsal fin is visible, consistent with the species.
